# electionsFR

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of electionsFR is to offer a set of functions to easily download and clean French electoral data from the public archive data-gouv.fr \url{https://www.data.gouv.fr/fr/organizations/ministere-de-l-interieur/}.

## Installation

You can install the development version of electionsFR from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("FredCassor/electionsFR")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to get access to datasets which refer to the Presidential election in 2002, published by the French Ministry of the Interior:
```{r example, eval=FALSE}
library(electionsFR)
get_presidentielle(2002)
```
